Bit of a long story, but I'll just get into it.

When I was a kid I lived in a pretty decent sized city. We had a dog, Bosco, who would occasionally escape the fence and I'd go chasing after him. One day when I was doing so, I met a boy about my age. He helped me look for him and we became good friends. We pretty much grew up together. I'd go over to his house after school and we'd play together. When we got older we started dating and saw each other as much as we could. Mind you, this was all in a time when kids our age didn't have cell phones.

My home life wasn't so great, so I spent as much time as I could at his place. I'd go over at like, 9am and I wouldn't leave until it was dark out.

We ended up moving, but I'd ride my bike well over a mile to go see him.

One day he moved away. I wasn't able to go say goodbye, get his number, any of that. I haven't been able to contact him since. About...ten or so years have gone by.

Over the years I've tried looking for him on various social media sites to attempt to re-connect with him but I've never had any luck.

I'm trying once again. I would really love to reconnect with him even though it's been so long...

I remember his old address, his first name and his sister's name. I think I remember where he went to school. I don't recall his last name though I think I know what it started with. I know...terrible memory. I even remember his dog and cat's name but god forbid I can remember his last name. -_-

How could I go about trying to find him? I've looked and looked but my searches have turned up nothing. I've checked facebook, Twitter, myspace, I've googled around trying to find anything I can.

I wasn't sure where to post this but hopefully here is okay.

Some men collect stamps, some collect gold coins, others collect girlfriends or mistresses but seldom keep more than a few at a time. I collect good hooks – the opening sentences of novels and short stories, crafted by master wordsmiths to suck the reader into the story. Some hooks can outlive the story itself. I can think of at least two, where I’ve long forgotten the story and the author but still remember fragments of the hook. One of them was a biography of a black celebrity, which went something like this: “When mom and pop got hitched mom was seventeen, pop was not yet nineteen and I was two.”

The other hook was a story about a petty crook being released from prison and met at the prison gates by an old friend with a car. He gets into the car and on the back seat he observes a peroxide blonde quietly chewing gum. “Hi,” he says to her, “my name is Garry.” “Pleased to meet ya, I am sure,” she says without parting from her gum and goes on to explain that she works as a senior secretary to the boss in a video lending library but only part time; the rest of the time she is a trainee hooker.
